label: VERIFIED
extraction: Verification Loop integration with hooks and continuous mode. Complements PostToolUse hooks but provides deeper verification. Hooks catch issues immediately; this skill provides comprehensive review. Continuous mode: run every 15 minutes or after major changes - set mental checkpoint after completing each function, component, before moving to next task. Run: /verify. Output format: VERIFICATION REPORT with Build/Types/Lint/Tests/Security/Diff each PASS/FAIL, overall READY/NOT READY for PR. Issues to Fix listed. Phase 1 Build: if fails STOP and fix before continuing. Phase 2 Type Check: report all type errors, fix critical ones. Phase 3 Lint: report warnings. Phase 4 Test: target 80% minimum coverage. Phase 5 Security: grep for secrets, api_keys, console.log. Phase 6 Diff Review: review each changed file for unintended changes, missing error handling, potential edge cases.
transfer_harness_fact: depends on W6 model freeze decision (D1)
